_comment: Sidecar provenance index for every conformance fixture and snapshot under this directory (#4732). A sidecar because the Rust parser uses deny_unknown_fields (#4442), so an inline _provenance key would be refused. entries is keyed by path relative to fixtures/. Each entry: provenance (one of 'hand-verified' = the expected output was derived or checked against a documented convention independent of the engines; 'regenerated' = the bytes were produced by running an engine, e.g. REGEN_EXPECTED=1, so they re-bless whatever the engine emits; 'unknown' = history does not say), issue (the issue named by the first commit that added the file, or null), evidence (short commit hash and what it states). Never record 'hand-verified' without evidence; use 'unknown'. Input fixtures (non-snapshots) are 'unknown' unless a commit states they were derived by hand. To add a fixture: add an entry in the same commit. When you regenerate a snapshot (REGEN_EXPECTED=1 or REGEN_ORACLE_CORPUS=1) set its entry to 'regenerated'; set 'hand-verified' only after actually checking the output against a convention, and cite it in evidence. tests/test_wasm_conformance.py fails on a missing entry, a stale entry, or a disallowed value. This file is not itself a fixture; the Python, Rust and web harnesses skip it by name.
